limitations: Reuses installed dependencies and existing compiled artifacts; no Docker or clean build proof.
Runs one authored state node with real persistence; no provider actions or Redis event dispatch are exercised.

topology.database: Fresh uniquely named database with actual CE/EE migrations; no source database reset or clone
topology.redis: Owned localhost ephemeral instance, persistence disabled
topology.temporal: Owned native Temporal CLI 1.5.1 / server 1.29.1, default namespace
topology.worker: Actual compiled entrypoint with compiled workflow/activity modules; no module overrides

assertions: Production runtime validates definition and registered state.set config before seeding
Production models create tenant-scoped pinned definition/version/run fixtures
Production dispatcher returns the expected workflow-runtime-v2:run identifier
Temporal completes the execution and database run is SUCCEEDED with completed_at
Exactly mark_ready and finish steps are persisted with SUCCEEDED status
Actual state-step snapshot contains meta.state native-ready
sourceIdentityNote: Revision is repository HEAD observed by the harness; compiled dependencies were reused, so this is not a clean source-to-image build certification.
